subject.title: [Feature]: CLI command to list pending exec approval requests

question: Should the active CLI implementation expose only authorized pending-approval inspection, or also permit `resolve/respond` decisions from the terminal?
rationale: Listing reveals sensitive command context, while resolution additionally exercises approval authority; source inspection cannot determine whether maintainers intend that broader operator capability to ship in this CLI increment.

options.title: Ship read-only listing first
options.body: Narrow the active PR to pending/list table and JSON output, leaving resolution and watch semantics for separately reviewed follow-up work.

options.title: Ship list and resolution together
options.body: Accept the broader CLI authority after live Gateway proof confirms authorization, sanitization, decision validation, and expired or ambiguous-ID handling.

recommendation.title: Ship read-only listing first
recommendation.body: Narrow the active PR to pending/list table and JSON output, leaving resolution and watch semantics for separately reviewed follow-up work.

likelyOwner.reason: They are connected to both the current CLI/backend history and the broader durable, cross-surface approval direction.
